title: Flow field
label: Turbulence
alt: A grid of short blue strokes turned by a wave pattern, so they flow like currents.
description: A grid of strokes, each turned by a sine and cosine field. Turbulence sets how quickly the field changes.

title: Spider type
label: Reach
alt: The word Type drawn as a web of thin blue threads between points on its outline.
description: Random pairs of points on the outline of a word are joined when they are close enough. Reach sets how far a thread may span.

title: Daylight
label: Latitude
alt: A radial chart of the hours between sunrise and sunset over a year at 52 degrees north.
description: Hours between sunrise and sunset through the year, read from a CSV file. Latitude picks the column.

title: Superformula
label: Exponent
alt: Thirty rotated and shrinking copies of a star-like curve, drawn as thin navy lines that form a twisting ribbon.
description: A superformula curve copied with a small turn and shrink each time. Exponent reshapes it, from a circle at 0 to sharp points when negative.
